# ThreeUI Community attribution

The proximity/spring navigation in
`packages/frontend/src/components/layout/workspace-dock-motion.ts` is adapted
from Meng To's ThreeUI Community `topDockController.ts` at commit
`68802d5428071ada5c20db8094b1649e6bb770ed`:
https://github.com/MengTo/threeui/blob/68802d5428071ada5c20db8094b1649e6bb770ed/src/shaders/animated-top-dock/topDockController.ts

Copyright (c) 2026 Meng To. Licensed under MIT; see LICENSE in this directory.
Local adaptations use native route links, transforms rather than changing item
widths, demand-driven fixed-step animation and hidden-tab/reduced-motion cleanup.
No Pro/Beta source, remote gallery media, fonts, branding or iframe runtime is
included. No ThreeUI npm dependency or additional Three.js runtime is installed.

The distribution also includes the complete MIT notice at
`/third-party/threeui-license.txt` in the Web public assets.
